title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 77 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 77)

content.overview: Former section 77 — Resort to arbitral or judicial proceedings belonged to the detailed conciliation regime in Part III of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. That detailed regime was superseded by the Mediation Act, 2023. This file is retained for historical and transition reference and must not be presented as current general conciliation law.
